result.final_text:
## What this letter says
You had a breast X-ray (screening mammogram) on 16 September 2026.
The clinic needs you to come back for more tests. This is called a recall.
Being called back does not mean you have cancer.
About 4 in 5 women who are called back do not have breast cancer.

## What you need to do
1. Come to your appointment at the Breast Assessment Clinic, Eastmoor Hospital. It is on Wednesday 7 October 2026 at 11:00.
2. Allow up to 4 hours for the visit.
3. You can bring a friend or family member with you.
4. If you cannot come, call 01632 960 733 as soon as possible.
5. Do not think that being called back means you have cancer. It does not.

## Dates and medicines
- 16 September 2026: your screening mammogram (breast X-ray).
- Wednesday 7 October 2026 at 11:00: your recall appointment at the Breast Assessment Clinic, Eastmoor Hospital.
- Medicines: the letter does not list any medicines.

At the appointment you may have more mammograms. You may have an ultrasound scan. In some cases you may have a biopsy (a small sample of tissue). You will usually get most of your results on the same day.

## Questions to ask your doctor
- Which tests will I have at my appointment?
- Will I have a biopsy?
- How will I get my results?

## When to get urgent help
The letter does not list specific warning signs.

If you are worried and it is not an emergency, call NHS 111. In an emergency, call 999.

---
*This explanation was made by a computer program to help you read your letter. It may contain mistakes. It does not replace your doctor, nurse or pharmacist. Always follow the letter and ask them if anything is unclear.*
